Under the pre-RRVOID rule it books a flat -2.00, so RRVOID is worth +1.84u here -- its first live money. moon: graded 365->366, staked 730.0->732.0, units 543.11->542.95; history[-1] carried the same -0.16 so the tracker total and the sparkline agree. ROOT CAUSE STILL LIVE: the scratch filter deletes a LOCKED slip wholesale (`if(t.locked){_killed[t.name]=1;return false;}`).
